component.name: Apsis
component.summary: Simple system snapshots and file restore for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: Apsis is a panel applet for the COSMIC desktop that creates, lists and deletes system snapshots on a backup disk with rsync, and restores single files from them. Its panel popup is a read-only overview and its window does the work; both look like a small terminal, work with the keyboard or the mouse, and follow the live COSMIC theme.

ul.li: Snapshots with rsync: later ones only copy what changed and hard-link the rest, at idle I/O priority
Snapshot list with comments and a details pane, and a bar of the backup disk's free space
Create and delete snapshots, one or several at a time, with one password prompt per few minutes through a small polkit-guarded helper
Browse a snapshot's files and restore them to a folder in your home, or back to their original place
Optional: keep the last N snapshots (preview, then confirm), and a reminder when the last snapshot is old
Settings: backup disk, home folders and filters
Vim-style keys and a command line, or the mouse; also opens as a resizable window from the app launcher

description.p: Snapshots use Timeshift's on-disk layout, so snapshots Timeshift made keep working, but Apsis doesn't need or run Timeshift. Manual only: there is no schedule, and snapshots are only deleted when you delete them. Encrypted (LUKS) backup disks and full-system restore aren't supported.

description.p: A cleaner look and a status you can read at a glance.

ul.li: The panel popup is a read-only overview: last snapshot, backup disk bar, newest snapshots
The window has four rooms: snapshots, create, schedule and log, with an apsis strip on top
The panel tooltip shows last, next and disk; the icon and an optional panel label show the state
The disk bar turns to the warning and critical colours when space runs low
Progress with the time left while a snapshot is created or restored
Every colour now comes from the COSMIC theme
A clearer message for a leftover from an interrupted snapshot

description.p: Apsis is standalone: it takes rsync snapshots itself and no longer needs Timeshift.

ul.li: Snapshots, delete and file restore without Timeshift; existing Timeshift snapshots keep working
Its own settings in /etc/apsis/config.toml, imported once from Timeshift's settings
rsync runs at idle I/O priority
Keep the last N snapshots (preview, then confirm) and a reminder when the last snapshot is old
A bar of the backup disk's free space, and progress with the time left
Removed: Timeshift's schedule and mode settings
Upgrading: open the settings once and press w to import
Delete several snapshots at once: mark them with space or J, then press d
Delete prompts and results show the date and comment instead of the raw name
Right-click menu: Close, and Remove or move applet
A manual page (man apsis) and a settings guide in the README
The settings explanations are no longer cut off
A .deb package for Pop!_OS and Ubuntu 24.04 or newer, attached to each release
A "How to use" guide in the README
Fixed: just vendor now writes vendor.tar, and just build-vendored builds offline
